notes.title: Thank you for an AMAZING Descenders Next Launch!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/698b71277a8237b4d25b0d703deb0e4786b3718b.png

Hi everyone!

It has been an incredible launch for Descenders Next! In just 24 hours, since we shadow dropped the game, we have had over 100,000 of you jumping in and taking on the snowy peaks & dirt tracks! For context, it took the original Descenders 18 MONTHS to get those kind of numbers, so we are truly amazed at how many of you turned out to the launch, and we can't thank you enough!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/a5fb11339c6570c36991328f3f000f04a6b639f2.png

So, we've been receiving super useful feedback from you all while you've been playing, and we've already got a plan of things we're wanting to look at! Here is a quick run-down of a few things we've seen pop up often:

 Speed: We know a lot of you are speed demons, but we hear that you'd like a bit more control over it too, so we're having a look at how we can make high speeds feel a bit easier to handle

 Brakes: We've seen a few of you ask for some sort of brake mechanic to help with the high speeds, so this is something we're also taking a look at, which would also help with the speed topic from earlier

 Multiplayer Game Modes: We hear you! We're looking at even more Multiplayer modes and opportunities to play with your friends, and more ways to smoothly progress through the map with your party

We have so much more to come and so many cool things to add, be sure to check out the roadmap below to see some of the things we've got cooking! Be sure to join our Discord too and chat with the community, and let us know your feedback there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/6eaedc141d4c35022e8900c2f0ed1fadc1e01ee8.png

We want to thank you again so much for the helpful feedback & love you've given Descenders Next in the last 24 hours alone! We can't wait to see what the future holds!

- RageSquid & No More Robots <3

notes.title: 5 Years of Descenders!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Can you believe it's been 5 years since the full launch of Descenders? And more since we put Descenders in Early Access? Neither can we! 

To celebrate, you can grab Descenders for 70% OFF as part of Steam's Replayability Fest!


To keep the celebrations going, we thought we'd go over some pretty cool milestones over the last few years and recap all the cool stuff we've brought to Descenders, and the future of it too... 👀

Over 25 maps added since launch

We haven't been shy in giving you new content since the launch of Descenders, adding over a whopping 25 maps, including some fan favourites such as Stoker, Jump City & more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30071847/f8f19f9252f8c493978e6570a55fcb3f669bf06f.jpg

We launched Descenders on consoles, Game Pass, and added crossplay

We've managed to bring Descenders to pretty much every platform you can think of! This has included adding Descenders to Game Pass, 4K support on Xbox consoles, and we've even brought it to mobile! Because there are so many of you who were wanting to play with your friends on different platforms, we added crossplay between Xbox & Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30071847/b22f0d5264e1614c06d0d99980fc700de78a9728.gif

Added new customization options

We've added a bunch of customization options to your rider since launch, including snazzy beards, LGBTQ flags for your bike, and a bunch more gear!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30071847/e561da49578f0f2a21f3ae5c0ea56ed797e8f63f.jpg

WE ADDED A BOUNCY CASTLE!

Enough said. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30071847/90ffdf51e15e54673e7ee06353d830b7b7debbe4.gif

What's Next?

Well, you're probably wondering about the future of Descenders, but don't worry... there are some big things coming Next. We're still working on our beloved Descenders so don't worry, we'll be dropping more news for you soon with more detail on everything we have planned, which you don't want to miss!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30071847/ba3e23837654613937b0d65b757655e50f427b9f.png

Thanks for tuning in to this very wholesome recap, and we'll see you soon!

- RageSquid & No More Robots

notes.title: MOD OF THE YEAR 2021 IS HERE!
notes.content:
Welcome to the THIRD ANNUAL Descenders Mod of the Year Competition!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30071847/db3eb5b9fb0d468fed651519bb4fb32e7b24640a.png

Once again we're looking to celebrate and reward the best Descenders mods with special prizes. It's been a GREAT year for Descenders, and we hope you've enjoyed playing it as much as we've all enjoyed working on it!


We're looking for the best and most innovative mods of the year. Is that one you've made? Have you played a mod this year that's blown you away? Here's your chance to show us which mods are the best of the best!

Here's how it's going to work this year:

1. Every Descenders mod uploaded to https://descenders.mod.io/ in 2021 and before the end of December 20 will be eligible to win a prize. Check the Modding Guide on how to get involved: https://descenders.mod.io/guides

2. Vote on your favourite mods by giving them the THUMBS UP on mod.io!

3. After December 20th, the Descenders team will pick their favourite mods, using community voting as a guide for which mods you like best.

4. On December 22, we'll announce the 5 best mods of 2021. 

The #5 and #4 will receive a Descenders game key, an item of choice and will be included in the MOTY 2021 leaderboard in the lobby. 

The top 3 modders will receive a Descenders game key, their respective Bronze, Silver and Gold kit and bike in-game, and will also be included in the MOTY 2021 leaderboard.

The creator of the Best Descenders Mod of 2021 will receive a $100 Steam Gift Card, to spend on whichever games they like over Christmas!

Think you can be the most creative, the most innovative or just deliver an amazing Descenders experience?

You have until the 20th of December!

You can also encourage people to vote on your creation on mod.io - while the decision lies with the devs, it'll definitely help your chances!

Don't forget that we have a whole community of modders working together on our Discord, so it's worth joining and chatting with them if you haven't already - they're a friendly bunch and between them and their YouTube tutorials, you'll get started in no time! 

Good luck, we can't wait to play what you're working on!

Hey everyone! 

It's been a while since our previous update but we're here again with a big one! New bikes, new physics, new tricks and so much more! 

We've also asked the creators of some of the most popular mods on mod.io if we could integrate their maps directly into the game, this way we can bring them to non-Steam versions of Descenders as well. Next to porting these mods over we've also made 2 original bike parks. BikeOut4, the next installment in the BikeOut series, full of new and frustrating obstacles to have a go at. Console/PC Game Pass players: the content of this update will be heading your way very soon.

New Bike parks.

New bike types.
The default Enduro bike can be changed to either a Hardtail or Downhill bike once you've obtained a sponsorship. You can change bike types in the Shed. 
New bike physics.
Different bikes will have their own physics. While the hardtail is made for flippy bois with it's agile lightweight frame, the downhill bike is a sturdy, heavy and fast mean machine! 
New tricks.
New tricks include the Tabletop, Superman Seatgrab, Barspin, Tailwhip and Tuck No Hander. Unfortunately to make room for these we had to say goodbye to the Candybar, we've built a memorial for it in Mt. Palumbo.
30+ New customization items to unlock in career mode.

- Lots of sound effects added to BikeOut obstacles.
- Ambient sound added to all bike parks.

RageSquid & No More Robots

Changes:

Multiplayer Career:
- The 'Casual' option in the Game Modes menu has been renamed to 'Multiplayer'. The lobby now defaults to a career session but a casual session without health and unlocks is still available in the lobby settings.

notes.title: May 7 -- Descenders 1.0 -- The Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30071847/0d793ecd6887770963f22eae19efc582606cdecd.gif

It's here. Version 1.0. Multiplayer. May 7.

After 15 months, and more than half a dozen major updates, Descenders is ready to leave Early Access. Thanks so much for taking this journey with us, and prepare yourselves for what the full Descenders experience has in store for you!

Here's what you can expect when The Multiplayer Update drops on May 7.

8 Player Online Multiplayer

Imagine this: You boot up Descenders, into the brand new central hub (more on this below). All of a sudden, a bike goes flying by... then another... and another!

When you boot up Descenders, and anytime you go back to the main lobby, your hub will be filled with other players. You can ride around with them, check out high scores, explore the outskirts of the hub, whatever you like.

When you dash off into a Career session, you won't be alone either. You'll encounter random riders, playing the same seed as you in real-time. There are no collisions so you can't smash into each other, but you can race through the world and explore together.

Lobby Up With Friends

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30071847/c3d7c8999d6e1da87d3780c96af38be5550087aa.gif

If you're not a fan of stranger danger, you can choose to start a Casual Lobby with friends. Invite your friends via Steam, and they can join up with you, and race through any of the worlds in the game.

It's up to you whether you race, explore, compete for score, mess around together, see if you can line up 7 riders and jump over all of them...

How you play Descenders with your friends is up to you!

Four Brand New Worlds

Was five worlds not enough for you? How about four brand new worlds you've never played before?

Introducing CareerPlus Mode. When you've collected enough Rep, you'll unlock this mode which essentially gives you a whole new Career to play through, complete with four new worlds.

Check out the gifs for a sneak peek. And speaking of new areas...

New Central Hub

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30071847/814f482ecc776286ca740d2f1124da9f43c18be1.gif

Whenever you boot up the game or finish a run, you'll be booted into the new central hub area. It's much, much bigger than the original hub, and features a bunch of really cool areas to explore.

You can still find The Shed, and your team's tent, but you'll also find other useful areas, like a giant leaderboard that updates to show your best scores.

Loads of Other Stuff

New music! New options! New sounds! New items! New bikes! New achievements! Play as a man or woman! New everything!

When the 1.0 Update hits on May 7, Descenders is going to feel like a very different game -- and we can't wait to share it with you.

See you all next week!

Love
RageSquid + No More Robots

notes.title: Teams rework is here!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/krqxxZZ.png

Hey everyone!

It's update time! We've overhauled the way teams/sponsorships worked, added a daily challenge mode, daily quests, and more! The road to sponsorship and the way you progress once sponsored has been changed. Therefore we've reset everyone's team. Your unlocks and Rep will not be taken away. It's a big one so let's get right into the changes.

Changes:

Teams rework:
- Obtaining a team no longer happens when reaching 1000 rep. Instead you'll have to complete 3 sponsor nodes on the world map instead before you get an offer.
- Sponsor nodes now give you a choice; you'll be able to start up an Arboreal, Enemy, or Kinetic track, regardless of which team you're in.
- Once sponsored you'll be able to complete daily sponsor tasks. These are refilled back up to 3 once per 24 hours. Completing sponsor tasks progresses you in your team, unlocking sponsor gear along the way.
- We've added the much requested option to leave your team! When leaving your team your sponsor progress will be reset to zero. Your Rep will not be reset, and your unlocks will not be taken away, but if you obtain a Kinetic sponsorship you won't be able to wear your Enemy gear, until you switch back to Enemy.
Daily Challenge:
- In the Ride menu, you'll now find the Daily Challenge option. This starts up a regular session, except that you only get one chance per day. 
- The seed for this session is the same for all players and changes every day.
- Scores for the Daily Challenge are stored on a separate leaderboard and are viewable in the Standings menu.
Bonus objectives rework:
- A common complaint was that bonus objectives often weren't doable on your current track. Our intention was that players could choose their next track based on the bonus objective they were given. In practice this didn't work very well so we shuffled some things around. The bonus objective will now be generated during track generation, it will randomly pick an objective from a pool of objectives that you're certainly able to complete on the current track.
New bonus level. By now you've probably found the construction site in Highlands, can you find the new one as well? This one features a new type of objective as well.
Session markers in freeride mode. Pressing 'T' or 'LeftStick' will plop down a marker in freeride levels, you can then respawn from there whenever you like.
Mixer plugin updates. Should fix performance problems.
Level generation build crew (all the yellow ones) are now included in level seeds. The old seeds will still work.
Switched a few keybindings around on controller. Check the keybindings menu for new bindings for: toggle UI, skip song, and reset camera angle.
Diminishing returns applied to stunts. Doing the same thing over and over will now award less Rep.
Initial game loading sequence sped up.
New team items added (by completing sponsor cards once sponsored).
New generic unlocks added to the random item pool.
Speedrun timer now in milliseconds.
Stoppie nerfed, Fakie buffed, Stoppies & Wheelies now have diminishing returns applied.
Construction site now has a separate finish line, so you are not forced to complete the objective.


Update platforms:
The update has been pushed live on Windows and Mac. Linux will be pushed live later today, or tomorrow at the latest. Xbox players will receive this update, combined with the next update, next month. This is due to the complicated and time costly nature of porting and updating on console.

Community:

Much love,

notes.title: The Rogue-Bike Update is here!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/7hsF1z5.jpg

Hey everyone!

The Rogue-Bike update is here! We've revamped most of the existing systems (rep system, world map) and we're introducing a big new feature: the build crew. Let's dive into the changes right away:

Changes:

World Map overhaul:
- Randomized start/finish line and level placement.
- Added more special nodes to the map. (Medic, First person, Danger zone, and more??)
- Day/night cycle. A new environment starts in the morning and playing a level advances the day. Reach the end of the world map before you run out of daylight.
Rep system overhaul:
- Rep can no longer be lost. The risk of losing reputation made end-game players play very safe, this wasn't very fun to watch. In order to see more sick tricks we're introducing:
- Flow (rep per minute). Flow is the reputation one earns per minute, making sure that the players who are on top of the flow leaderboards are actually the most entertaining to watch as they constantly have to do the sickest stunts.
- New sessions start at 0 rep, the goal is to reach the end of the last environment with as much rep as possible. Session rep is added to your account rep after each session. Leaderboards will track 'best session rep', 'flow' (only on successfully completed runs), and 'overall account rep'.
- Diminishing returns. Doing the same trick over and over will reward fewer rep each time.
Build crew:
- Build crew is a way to customize and tweak a session to the players liking.
- At certain rep milestones during a session new crew members will be unlocked. The player will have to choose one out of four randomly generated crew members (modifiers). Crew members last until the end of a session and a fresh session starts with 0 crew members.
- Crew members can be: wider paths when generating levels, higher bunny hops, decrease in off-road friction, generate fewer obstacles, always show the compass, and many others. Right now we've implemented 22 different build crew members and there are more to come! If you have ideas for other crew members, let us know!
Removed the 'Practice' option when starting a new session. Practice session was a way to ride without consequences but after removing reputation losses this no longer feels needed.
Removed dawn and night random visual modifiers. Storm can still randomly occur. Dusk now appears after having played 7 levels in the same environment. Night appears 2 levels after dusk. Completing a boss jump and entering a new environment resets the day timer.
Mixer integration. Allows for interaction between viewers and streamers on the Mixer streaming platform.
Speedrun timer. Enable in the gameplay settings to show a speedrun timer during your sessions. This timer ONLY pauses during loading screens.
Added and tweaked a bunch of sound effects.
Added a few new outfits, bikes, and accessories.
Updated to a newer version of the Unity engine. This should improve the experience on lower end computers and macs.
Performance upgrades across the board. We had to do a ton of performance upgrades when working on the Xbox version of Descenders. We took the ones that were applicable to PC/Mac/Linux and carried those over to the Steam version of Descenders.
Updated the Steam plugin. This fixes the bug where some players have no leaderboards.
Bugfix: pressing 'equip now' in the game over screen now actually equips the newly unlocked items.


Reputation reset
With the new rep system and the new leaderboards we're resetting everyone's reputation. Based on your current rep we've handed out a few legacy items. Everyone who scored at least 1 reputation has received an accessory item. If you obtained 50.000 rep you've received another legacy item. And if you managed to obtain an impressive 250.000 rep you've gotten a third item on top of that.

Community

Much love,
RageSquid & No More Robots

notes.title: The Rogue-Bike Update: Coming May 15th
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30071847/bace601ac7efa09b896d722a5aeb9d131ecb7c24.jpg

Hey everyone!

We're here today to give you some pretty exciting news.

A couple of months ago, the RageSquid team came up with a massive idea for Descenders that would make the game even more exciting and fulfilling, while fixing some of the issues people were having with the roguelike elements and the Rep system.

And now we're finally ready to unveil what we're calling The Rogue-Bike Update -- and it's coming on May 15th.

Here's what you can expect:

The New World Map

Currently, you play through the Career Mode world by world, and move from left to right on the world map. Other than picking what the new level will roughly contain in terms of steepness, stunts and curves, there isn't much to it. Until now.

With the Rogue-Bike Update, you'll now be tasked with exploring a randomized world map, filled with special nodes to discover. Your goal is still to reach the boss jump and clear it to move on to the next world, but you might want to ride around a little first and see what the world has to offer...

But don't ride around for *too* long. If you spend too much time exploring, the sun will begin to set, and you'll be plunged into darkness, making completing the boss jump a whole lot trickier.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30071847/786e03a09f23cee5d42f9b9015dedd0f425d0e9d.png

The New Rep System

The current Rep system is fine, but we've found that it stops the best players from wanting to take risks. All this will change with the Rogue-Bike Update.

From May 15th, each new run that you do will set your Session Rep back to zero, and you'll only earn Rep, rather than losing it. You'll also now be judged based on your Flow -- that is, your Rep per minute.

In other words, the better you ride and the more tricks you do, the better your Flow. And when you finish a Session, your Session Rep will be added to your Total Rep. Easy!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30071847/28dd3d54c34c3f4ed83cd0040059e6558e315551.jpg

Crew Members

Right now, once you've unlocked Canyon or Peaks, you might as well keep restarting from those worlds to reach the final boss. With the Rogue-Bike Update, we introduce Crew Members, who give you a reason to start from Highlands each time.

Every time you earn a certain amount of Rep on a run, you'll unlock a new Crew Member. These Crew Members will give you special mutators, such as softening all your landing impacts, or adding extra steepness or stunts to every level.

These mutators allow you to play the game your own way, and pick the abilities that matter to you. You can, of course, still start runs from later worlds, but you won't earn as many mutators that way.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30071847/5c7f08f217b55f796a96f4b78dba75546c4638a5.png

But what about my current Rep?

On May 15th, we will reset all Rep scores. However, we will be giving special items to each and every Descenders player based on how much Rep they've earned before then:

notes.title: Newsfeed/performance update
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/NY5Sn47.png
Hey all!

We're back again with a small update! We've heard your feedback on the rep system and world map and we agree with you, they really need some work. We're super eager to rework these things but that's going to be a big project. Before we can start on a major overhaul like this we wanted to get a few smaller things out of the way. One of the things in this update is the newsfeed. This way we can communicate more information to you without having to upload new builds. This is also a place where we can highlight community clips and images. 
Apart from this we did a lot of small fixes and updates, which I'll list below.

Changes:

Added multiple UI sound effects.
Added new character voice sounds and removed the temporary voice effects from the rider (goodbye Cedar!).
Added a newsfeed in the main menu. This is where we'll place information about the game, its updates, and community highlights.
Physics raycasting update, this new method for wheel collision is about 16x faster and should even be more precise as well.
[strike]Mixer integration. Streamers who stream on Mixer.com can now enable interactivity in the gameplay options menu. In career and practice mode the viewers can influence level generation and hand out extra reputation when the streamer performs sweet tricks. In freeride mode the viewers can submit level seeds for the streamer to play.[/strike] We've had to disable this because of issues while building the executable. Expect this in a hotfix some time next week.
Added a few more unlockable items ;)
GPU performance improvements across the board. We mainly tried to pull the FPS in the forest environment more in line with the rest of the environments. 
Big CPU performance upgrades, should be most notable for people with low end CPUs.
Bugfix: removed bonus objective UI from freeride mode.
Bugfix: UI buttons would sometimes randomly scale up.
Bugfix: Button navigation in game modes menu fixed.
Bugfix: Couple of localization errors fixed.
Bugfix: 1460 is now 1440 lol
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oHpetnUFQMA&t=0m35s


Next up:
As stated above we are super hyped to start working on the new world map and the new reputation system. We want to move away from a percentage based penalty system and towards a system which rewards taking risks and doing sick moves, rather than spending as much time as possible grinding levels in a safe manner. While we're working on this we're definitely going to keep you up to date through our social channels and on Discord. Do keep in mind that this next update could take a month or two, this is quite a big undertaking for the small team that we are.
Next to these big overhauls we're also going to be travelling a lot in the near future. There are several events we'll be going to and if you happen to go to any of these, please drop by our booth and say hi, we'd love to meet you all in person <3
You'll be able to find us here:

- EGX Rezzed (April 13-15, London, UK) - Mike (& Roel/Lex?)

If you want to keep up to date with the known issues and our current plans, join our Discord, or have a look at the Roadmap! As always, we'd love to hear your thoughts!

Much love,

notes.title: Freeride Update Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Unfortunately the previous update (Freeride mode update) shipped with a couple of bugs. Today we're pushing a small hotfix to resolve these issues. Please keep your feedback coming so we know about these bugs and we can keep fixing them as soon as possible!

Changes:

Freeride levels can now be quit without having to stop riding. You can now also respawn while riding when you have health set to infinite.
In Freeride mode, trying to select environments the player hasn't unlocked yet will now trigger a popup explaining why. The same goes for trying to select the Boss Jump physical modifier.
Level seed now always shows on the bottom right of the screen in the post-game UI.
Bugfix: Freeride UI labels now localize properly when selecting non-latin languages.
Bugfix: achievements are no longer triggered in Freeride/Practice modes.
Bugfix: post-game UI health bug fixed (1 HP bug).
Bugfix: rep now properly displays after a Freeride level.
Bugfix: Golden Run, Made it, and True Descender achievements now trigger again. 


Known issues:

macOS stability is a big problem, crashes occur more frequent than on other platforms and framerates are lower than we want them to be. We're aware of this and currently looking into getting external help to fix these problems.
Steam leaderboards bug. Some players have no entry on the leaderboards and we're having a hard time reproducing the bug but we're still well aware of the bug and working on it.
General performance levels are not yet where we want them to be. We're constantly looking at ways to improve this.

notes.title: Freeride Update!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/9mBAYtJ.png

Hey everyone!

Another week, another update! It's been 3 weeks since we launched and it's been one hell of a ride so far. We're overwhelmed with your love and feedback and we're changing the course of the game to make sure we can implement the things you want to see. As an example of this we're introducing the 'Freeride' mode in today's patch! In this much requested mode you're able to generate levels by setting the variables that are used in the generation process, as seen in the above screenshot.

Another highly requested feature we're adding today is the ability to load up a level by its generation seed. If you see a level you like, write down the seed (seen in bottom right corner of the pause menu) and play it again in the Freeride mode. You can also share this seed with others so that they're able to play the exact same level!

Changes:

Added Freeride mode. In this mode you can generate a level to your liking, play with or without health, and rep changes will not be saved.
Added the option to load a level from a generation seed! This means you can screencap or write down the seed when you see a level you like and replay it at a later time, or share it with others. The seed for the level you're playing can be found in the bottom right of the pause menu.
Added the option to immediately equip an item when you unlock it.
Added a new t-shirt of Extraordinary quality, created by the Foodz company.
Added a shirt for people who participated in the beta back in October 2017. Codes for this item will be going out by e-mail.
Bugfix: updated a few grammar mistakes in translations. 
Bugfix: team nodes are now correctly named when hovering over them in the world map.
Bugfix: fixed 2 wrongly labelled songs.
macOS/Linux: applied the hotfix that was rolled out last week on Windows. This contains fixes for a world map bug (game booted up in an empty world map), and it adds a few missing keybinds in the key rebinding menu.


Known issues:

macOS stability is a big problem, crashes occur more frequent than on other platforms and framerates are lower than we want them to be. We're aware of this and currently looking into getting external help to fix these problems.
Steam leaderboards bug. Some players have no entry on the leaderboards and we're having a hard time reproducing the bug but we're still well aware of the bug and working on it.
General performance levels are not yet where we want them to be. We're constantly looking at ways to improve this.


If you want to keep up to date with the known issues and our current plans, join our Discord, or have a look at the Roadmap! We'd love to hear your thoughts!

Much love,

notes.title: Early Access week 2 update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've seen your bug reports and we're here with the first batch of fixes. I'll list the changes in this build and I'll quickly go over what we're working on next! Please keep the bug reports coming, send all your crash logs and output logs to lex@ragesquid.com so we can have a look at what's going on and fix it!

Changes:

Added Portuguese and Estonian translations.
Added dirt bumps to Highlands for more interesting off-road action.
Added the option to rebind keyboard controls.
Added the option to report broken level generations while playing. Seeing a flying tent, a tree on the track, or anything weird going on in the level? Let us know!
Added a link to the Liquicity (OST) youtube channel in the Community menu.
Added a 'Golden Run' achievement. Obtained by finishing a complete run without bailing.
Most definitely did NOT add new redeemable codes.
Made tweaks to particles and to the forest environment, may result in minor performance gain.
Anti-exploit: made sure a level can't be farmed by alt+f4'ing out of a bail.
Anti-exploit: disabled nodes behind the player on the world map so you can only move forward, to prevent Rep farming.
Bugfix: fixed a serialization issue when resuming a session after a crash/alt+f4.
Bugfix: removed Rep bonus when finishing a practice run.
Bugfix: updated a few grammar mistakes in translations.
Bugfix: fixed tents & cars floating in the air.


Currently working on:

Performance (high priority).
Crashes/stability (high priority).
Steam leaderboards bug.
A different way of implementing the Rep system (will update you when we know more about this).
An alternative to practice mode. Possibly allowing the player to play with all variables (health/stunts/modifiers/steepness/etc).
Tools for speedrunning.


If you want to keep up to date with the known issues and our current plans, join our Discord, or have a look at the Roadmap!

More soon!

Much love,
RageSquid & Friends

UPDATE: Anyone who quit the game using Alt + F4 before the update might find that when they boot the game up again, they're now stuck at the level select screen. We're putting out a fix soon to stop this happening! In the meantime, you can use this quick workaround: http://steamcommunity.com/app/681280/discussions/0/1693788384128913984/

UPDATE 2: The above bug has been fixed for Windows users. Mac and Linux users still have to apply the above fix until we are able to push new builds. Should be early next week!
